name: Byron Bay
tagline: Surf, lighthouse walks and a laid-back beach town
summary: Byron Bay is a relaxed surf town on Australia's most easterly point. Walk the Cape Byron track to the lighthouse to spot dolphins and migrating whales, surf the Pass, swim at Wategos, explore hinterland villages and rainforest waterfalls, and eat well in a town known for its cafés.
seasonNote: Whales June to November; summer holidays are crowded and pricey.
arrival: Fly to Ballina or Gold Coast airport (35 to 50 minutes away).
gettingAround: Walk and bike in town; a car for the hinterland.
cashTip: Cards and tap-to-pay work almost everywhere; tipping isn't expected.
foodTip: Brunch cafés, fish and chips, acai bowls.
